title: Will Shade's last years and death
summary: Lewis recalls Will Shade living nearby, sick for years, burned in a fall, and how Lewis and his wife brought him food.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Mmhmm. Did you ever know Shade? You told me you knew Will Shade.

Oh I know him. Oh yeah. He was living right down the street here. Before he died. He got five or six doves down the street there. He just got sick you know. Lang around a long time. He was sick for five or six years. And his wife. His wife died before he did. Mmhmm. And he obviously he lived about a year behind Jan May didn't he?
Yeah just about a year behind his wife.
What did he die? How did he die?

Well he just sick. He just sick and just old you know. He just got so he couldn't walk and he burnt himself pretty bad. He was so weak he fell on the stove and just like to burn yourself up and he never did get over with that. I used to, my wife used to send him food up there. I used to take him food up there for him. He'd cook and I'd take him, you know, something to eat and probably everybody around knew him, done that. He was getting a little check to pay his rent and there was different things like that.
